lines: No workstation means I notice things. People underestimate the unemployed at their own peril.
Some jobs use tools. Mine seems to be hearing every <wavy>rumor</wavy> before lunch.
I am between callings, which is a polite way to say the village has not decided what to blame me for yet.
People are talking about you differently. I am very good at hearing that sort of thing.
You changed the village's mind a little. That is harder than moving a bed.
